file_to_url: strip output_dir prefix, strip trailing 'index.html', ensure leading slash (e.g. site/about/index.html -> /about/, site/index.html -> /)
second_source_of_truth: sitemap.xml (requires site_url to be set in mkdocs.yml, otherwise it emits an empty urlset)
gotchas: sitemap.xml is emitted but contains an empty <urlset> unless site_url is set in mkdocs.yml — it cannot be used as verification until then

search/search_index.json 'docs' entries are per-heading anchors (a 1-page starter has 3 docs: the page plus #commands and #project-layout sections), so its doc count is always >= page count and must not be used as a page count
every page is emitted as <path>/index.html (never foo.html), and 404.html is the only top-level non-index page — so pattern '**/index.html' alone is a complete page selector
with an explicit 'nav:' in mkdocs.yml the page list is purely config-driven: .md files present in docs/ but absent from nav produce no output file and no sitemap entry
